tagline: Air underneath and bolsters on three sides: a raised bed for big dogs who run hot.
lead: A big dog who runs hot gets air underneath them and still has something to lean against.
value: One bed for summer in the garden and winter in a warm kitchen, on a powder-coated steel frame with a 150 × 95cm deck.
intro: Harbour is an XL elevated dog bed: a 150 × 95cm mesh deck with bolsters on three sides, on a powder-coated steel frame with non-slip rubber feet. It snaps together without tools.
points: The mesh deck sits clear of the floor, so heat moves away instead of building up.
Bolsters for a chin, a back or a sideways flop, with an open side to step in.
A powder-coated steel frame under a 150 × 95cm deck.
It stays put on tiles, laminate or decking.
best_for: Large and giant breeds who run hot but still want something to lean against, indoors or in the garden.
fit_note: The bolsters take up part of the outside footprint. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Wipe or rinse the mesh and frame and let it dry fully. Check the feet and joints occasionally, and keep it on a level surface.

seo_description: A raised mesh dog bed for big dogs who run hot: air underneath, bolsters on three sides to lean on. Steel frame, rubber feet, 150 × 95cm XL deck.
